instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.input:
bg=7

def panel(color, pattern):
    # pattern is 3x3 of the tile color; the 5x5 tile keeps a solid 1-cell frame,
    # and its center is the complement of the small pattern.
    return [[color]*5] + [[color]+[color if v==bg else bg for v in row]+[color] for row in pattern] + [[color]*5]

tile1=panel(1, [[1,7,1],[1,7,1],[1,1,1]])
tile4=panel(4, [[4,7,7],[4,4,7],[4,7,4]])
tile6=panel(6, [[6,6,6],[7,6,7],[6,6,6]])
out=[[7]*7]
for tile in [tile1]:
    out += [[7]+row+[7] for row in tile]
out.append([7]*7)
out += [[7]+row+[7] for row in tile4]
out.append([7]*7)
out += [[7]+row+[7] for row in tile6]
out.append([7]*7)
print(len(out), {len(r) for r in out})
for r in out: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))
